camel_example: aliyun rds DescribeDBInstancesByExpireTime --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmy0000' --PageNumber 1 --Expired true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExpirePeriod 180 --Tags '{"key1":"value1"}' --proxyId API
description_en: Queries the information about an ApsaraDB RDS instance based on the remaining subscription duration of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于通过包年包月实例的剩余可用时间查询RDS实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instances-by-expire-time --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --proxy-id API --expire-period 180 --expired true --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --tags '{"key1":"value1"}' --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancesByExpireTime

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The number of remaining days for which the instances are available. Valid values: 0 to 180
parameters.help_zh: 实例剩余可用天数。取值：0~180
parameters.name: expire_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query instances that have expired. Valid values:

True: queries instances that have expired.
False: does not query instances that have expired
parameters.help_zh:
实例的过期状态，取值：

True：已过期
False：未过期
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：1~100。

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The number of the page to return. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer类型的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The tag that is added to the instance. Each tag is a key-value pair that consists of two parts: TagKey and TagValue. You can specify a maximum of five tags in the following format for each request: `{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}`
parameters.help_zh: 查询绑定有该标签的实例，包括TagKey和TagValue。单次最多支持传入5组值，格式：`{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"...}`
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to obtain the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id
